data.body: INFO: Security-positive change. The resolve_structured.rs rewrite closes a JSON output-integrity weakness — the previous hand-rolled escaping only handled double-quotes (via .replace('"', ...)) and interpolated path.display() unescaped, so a conflict path/workspace name containing a backslash, newline, control char, or quote could emit malformed or forgeable JSON to downstream consumers. Switching to serde_json::json! escapes all cases correctly; regression test with a quoted"name.txt path confirms. release_prepare.rs's move to toml/toml_edit operates only on trusted local manifests with no new attack surface. No exploitable issues.

data.reason: No security concerns. Net hardening: JSON output now escaped via serde_json (was partial hand-rolled escaping), TOML editing via toml_edit on trusted local manifests. No auth/secrets/crypto/injection surface introduced.
